name: Project Alpha
description: A customer-facing web application for managing user accounts and subscriptions.
setup_instructions:
1. Clone the repository
2. Run `npm install`
3. Copy .env.example to .env
4. Run `docker-compose up -d` for database
5. Run `npm run dev` to start development server
onboarding_notes: New developers should start with the Getting Started guide in the wiki. Make sure to request access to the staging environment within your first week.
